import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import lightgbm as lgb

# Define paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))

# Extract species column names in order from sample submission (excluding 'id')
species_names = sample_sub.columns[1:].tolist()
species_to_idx = {name: idx for idx, name in enumerate(species_names)}

# Define feature columns (exclude 'id' and 'species')
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]

# Prepare training data
X_full = train_df[feature_cols]
y_full_labels = train_df["species"].map(species_to_idx)

# Split training data into train and validation (80/20)
# Important: This split defines the hold-out set for validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_full, y_full_labels, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_full_labels, random_state=42
)

# Initialize model
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    verbose_eval=False,
)

# Train model on training split only (not full data)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Calculate validation logloss (Official metric)
# y_val contains integer indices 0-98 matching species_to_idx order
y_val_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, y_val_proba)
print(f"Validation LogLoss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]
test_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Format submission dataframe
# Ensure columns match sample_submission order exactly
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_proba, columns=species_names)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_df["id"])
submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
